title: TURTLE BEACH UNVEILS THE ALL-NEW STEALTH™ PRO II WIRELESS GAMING HEADSET -- FLAGSHIP SOUND, COMFORT, AND FLEXIBILITY- WITHOUT COMPROMISE
summary: TURTLE BEACH UNVEILS THE ALL-NEW STEALTH(tm) PRO II WIRELESS GAMING HEADSET - FLAGSHIP SOUND, COMFORT, AND FLEXIBILITY- WITHOUT COMPROMISE Certified Hi-Res Wireless Audio and Dolby Atmos(r) Spatial Audio Deliver Higher Audio Quality for a More Accurate and Immersive Gaming Experience The Exclusive CrossPlay 2.0 System Supports Up to Four USB Wireless Transmitters, Wirelessly Switch between Xbox, PlayStation, PC, and More Unidirectional 9mm Floating Microphone Features AI-based Noise Reduction For Broadcast-Quality Communication SAN DIEGO April 16, 2026 Leading gaming accessories maker Turtle Beach Corporation (Nasdaq: TBCH), today revealed the all-new Stealth(tm) Pro II wireless multiplatform gaming headset which distinctly sits at the audio summit as the complete gaming peripheral. The Stealth(tm) Pro II is the successor to the highly lauded Stealth(tm) Pro and represents both Turtle Beachs legacy of gaming sound and the future
